meta.name: slideshow
meta.description: Author a HyperFrames slideshow — a presentation, pitch deck, or interactive deck with discrete slides, fragment reveals, branching, hotspot navigation, and built-in presenter mode with speaker notes; also converts an existing page into a deck. Output is a navigable deck, not a rendered MP4. If the user didn't explicitly ask for a slideshow, confirm before authoring. Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把内容编排成可翻页的演示文稿
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果经常需要把想法整理成演示文稿
copy.tagline_en: Create a navigable slideshow from your content
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you regularly need to turn ideas into a slide deck

howto.what: 装好后,Claude 会用 HyperFrames 把内容做成可翻页演示:多个幻灯片、分步揭示、分支跳转、热区导航,带演讲备注和演示模式;也能把已有网页转成幻灯片。产出是可导航的演示,不是视频。
howto.when: 当你明确要求制作幻灯片,或提到“presentation”“pitch deck”等相近词,或要转换某个网页时,会先确认是否做成 HyperFrames slideshow,确认后才动手。

say.text: 把这份大纲做成分页幻灯片,每页加演讲备注。
say.note: 会生成可导航的演示文稿,不是视频。

say.text: 把我的产品页转成幻灯片,保留原有动效和交互。
say.note: 它会先确认,再按源页面保真转换。

say.text: 加一个分支页,点击图表可跳到详细数据页。
say.note: 分支页通过热区进入,不属于主线。

howto.what_en: Claude authors a HyperFrames slideshow — discrete slides, fragment reveals, branching, hotspot navigation, presenter mode with speaker notes — and can convert an existing page into a deck. The output is a navigable deck, not an MP4.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you explicitly ask for a slideshow, or mention adjacent words like “presentation” or “pitch deck”, or ask to convert a page; it confirms before building unless already routed via /hyperframes.

say_en.text: Turn this outline into paginated slides with speaker notes.
say_en.note: Produces a navigable deck, not a video.

say_en.text: Convert my product page into a slideshow, keeping its motion and interactions.
say_en.note: It confirms first, then ports the source page.

say_en.text: Add a branch page that opens detailed data when the chart is clicked.
say_en.note: Branch pages are reached via hotspots, outside the main line.
